content: Transactional outbox: commit a state change and the event announcing it in one local ACID transaction so there is no window where state moved but the event is missing (applied internally to state column + run_events written together). Outbox guarantees at-least-once, not exactly-once; exactly-once side effects live on the consumer side via an inbox / processed_events ledger keyed by event id: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, apply the side effect only if the row was inserted. For Dark Factory: each external effect (branch, commit SHA, push, PR number/URL, clarification comment id) gets a persisted identifier and a check-before-act guard; publishing becomes a mini-saga where populated ids short-circuit completed steps; GitHub comment ingestion dedupes on comment id and never creates a new run.
